title: How childcare accounts support families
titleZh: 托育账户如何为家庭提供支持

sentences.text: As the autumn school holidays approach, some working parents need childcare while they continue to work.
sentences.zh: 随着秋季学校假期临近，一些在职家长在继续工作期间需要托育服务。

sentences.text: On 13 October 2026, HM Revenue and Customs published a reminder about the UK's Tax-Free Childcare scheme.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月13日，英国税务海关总署发布了一则有关英国免税托育计划的提醒。

sentences.text: The announcement reports that 601,620 families received government top-ups in June, worth £55.7 million in total.
sentences.zh: 公告称，6月有601,620个家庭获得政府追加补贴，总额为5,570万英镑。

sentences.text: These figures describe June, rather than the number of families using the scheme during the October holidays.
sentences.zh: 这些数字描述的是6月，而不是10月假期期间使用该计划的家庭数量。

sentences.text: For every £8 that parents put into an eligible child's account, the government adds another £2.
sentences.zh: 家长每向符合条件的子女账户存入8英镑，政府就另加2英镑。

sentences.text: Parents can normally receive up to £500 every three months, with a yearly limit of £2,000 for each eligible child.
sentences.zh: 通常，每名符合条件的子女每三个月最多可获得500英镑补贴，年度上限为2,000英镑。

sentences.text: The limits are higher for eligible children with disabilities: £1,000 every three months and £4,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 对于符合条件的残障子女，上限更高：每三个月1,000英镑，每年4,000英镑。

sentences.text: Families with more than one eligible child must open a separate account for each child, rather than sharing one household account.
sentences.zh: 有多名符合条件子女的家庭必须为每名子女单独开户，而不是共用一个家庭账户。

sentences.text: The money can pay for approved care, including nurseries, clubs before or after school, and holiday activity clubs.
sentences.zh: 这些钱可以支付获认可的托育服务，包括托儿所、课前或课后俱乐部，以及假期活动俱乐部。

sentences.text: Parents can use their deposits immediately or leave the money in the account until they need it, and unused money can be withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 家长可以立即使用存款，也可以把钱留在账户中待需要时使用；未使用的款项可以取出。

sentences.text: Receiving help is not automatic for every working family, because age, income and other benefit conditions apply.
sentences.zh: 并非每个在职家庭都能自动获得帮助，因为还存在年龄、收入和其他福利方面的条件。

sentences.text: The announcement directs readers to the official guidance for the full eligibility rules that apply to their circumstances rather than treating employment alone as sufficient.
sentences.zh: 公告引导读者查阅官方指南了解适用于自身情况的完整资格规则，而不是认为有工作就足够了。

sentences.text: Account holders also need to confirm their details every three months to continue receiving the government contribution.
sentences.zh: 账户持有人还需要每三个月确认个人资料，才能继续获得政府补贴。

sentences.text: This reminder combines information about paying for care now with the steps needed to keep that support available later.
sentences.zh: 这则提醒既介绍当前如何支付托育费用，也说明以后继续获得支持所需的步骤。

sentences.text: The published average top-up was £93 per family in June; it describes that group and month, rather than promising each applicant the same payment.
sentences.zh: 公布的6月每户平均追加补贴为93英镑；这描述的是该群体和月份，而不是承诺每位申请者获得相同款项。

sentences.note: can ... or ...列出立即使用与留待以后两种选择；can be withdrawn是被动表达，说明未使用款项可以取出。

questions.zh: 这则报道的哪一部分与日常生活最相关？为什么？
